comparison.objective: File a steel block flat to a scribed line without overcutting; candidate tunes a hydraulic damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR requires bimanual file control, balanced pressure, directional strokes, and material-removal regulation. Candidate requires fine hex access, collar rotation, locking, and iterative impact-response adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires specified remaining height/flatness, no cut below the line, tool return, and a stable hold. Candidate requires two energy-, force-, travel-, rebound-, and drift-bounded stop cycles.
comparison.reason: Both involve feedback and force-sensitive adjustment, but material removal to geometry and dynamic damper commissioning are meaningfully different abilities.
